sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.section_title: FDCAN extended ID filter configuration register (FDCAN_XIDFC)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.5.21 "FDCAN extended ID filter configuration register (FDCAN_XIDFC)" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3701.
sections.section_content:
Settings for 29-bit extended message ID filtering. The FDCAN extended ID filter
configuration register controls the filter path for standard messages as described in
Figure963.
Address offset: 0x0088
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:24 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 23:16 LSE[7:0]: List size extended
0: No extended message ID filter
1-128: Number of extended ID filter elements
>128: Values greater than 128 are interpreted as 128.
These are write-protected bits, write access is possible only when bit CCE and bit INIT of
FDCAN_CCCR register are set to 1.
Bits 15:2 FLESA[13:0]: Filter list extended start address
Start address of extended message ID filter list (32-bit word address, see Table716: Extended
message ID filter element).
These are write-protected bits, write access is possible only when bit CCE and bit INIT of
FDCAN_CCCR register are set to 1.
Bits 1:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
